title: Glowing popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffee88' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ffcc33' stop-opacity='0.12'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcc33' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stickGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8924a'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e8b96a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c8924a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='iceGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ff4d6d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e63e5c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='shine' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3c6' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb3c6' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow aura around popsicle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='40' ry='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- wooden stick -->
  <rect x='45' y='68' width='10' height='24' rx='3' fill='url(#stickGrad)'/>
  <rect x='47' y='70' width='3' height='20' rx='1.5' fill='#f5d99a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- popsicle body -->
  <rect x='28' y='14' width='44' height='58' rx='16' fill='url(#iceGrad)'/>

  <!-- lighter rounded top edge -->
  <rect x='28' y='14' width='44' height='58' rx='16' fill='#ff8aa0' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- highlight shine -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='30' rx='7' ry='14' fill='url(#shine)'/>

  <!-- little drip at bottom of popsicle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='73' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e63e5c'/>

  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <g fill='#ffe680'>
    <polygon points='70,18 72,24 78,24 73,28 75,34 70,30 65,34 67,28 62,24 68,24'/>
    <polygon points='24,50 25.5,54 30,54 26.5,56.5 28,61 24,58.5 20,61 21.5,56.5 18,54 22.5,54' opacity='0.85'/>
    <polygon points='76,48 77,51 80,51 77.5,53 78.5,56 76,54 73.5,56 74.5,53 72,51 75,51' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- little cute face on popsicle -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#3a1e2a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#3a1e2a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='38.8' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38.8' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M44 48 Q50 54 56 48' stroke='#3a1e2a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff8aa0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff8aa0' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
